fixture.description: Synthetic high-contrast capability and bounded quality fixture with one unique OCR code, two spatially distinct colored squares, and three countable bottom-row circles.
fixture.ownership: Generated in-repository; no external or copyrighted image input.

layout.top_banner: Pale yellow banner containing the black four-character code B7X9.

artifact_processing_receipt.scope: Offline local-only processor observation; it does not prove model loading or XPU vision execution.

cases.prompt: Read the four-character code in the pale yellow banner at the top. Answer with exactly the four characters and nothing else.
cases.grounding: The answer is encoded only in the image pixels and is not stated in the prompt.

cases.prompt: What color is the large square on the right? Answer with exactly one lowercase color word.
cases.grounding: The image contains same-sized left and right squares with different colors, so position is required.

cases.prompt: How many black circles are in the bottom row? Answer with exactly one digit.
cases.grounding: The count and bottom-row constraint are present only in the image pixels.

required_response_gates: exact case-specific prompt token count including the 64 image tokens
one request-body, answer, usage, and prompt-detail hash plus one prompt-token count across all three repetitions

credit_scope.maximum_client_credit: necessary fixed-fixture capability and bounded quality evidence for the single intended cell
additional_required_gates: one-image/video-zero limits, processor cache disabled, and encoder TP weights mode
same-boot text recovery and bounded semantic quality gates
descendant-aware controlled stop and clean process/listener/cache/RPC/four-card/journal postflight
explicitly_no_credit: other TP, MTP, graph, KV, context, modality, artifact, or runtime cells
protected eager-text results or headline values
